apks.help: No APK is published. You build it on a PC from your own Google Play copy of GTA: San Andreas (ARM64, version 2.11.311) with the repository's scripts.

steps.text: Download the repository. Export your installed Google Play game with EXPORT_PLAY_APKS.bat, then run BUILD_AND_INSTALL.bat (or BUILD_AND_INSTALL.sh). Select the exported APK folder and the audio package when asked. The script patches the game, installs it and copies the data to the headset.
Open GTA San Andreas VR from Library > Unknown Sources.

notes: The payload's latest_version is null, but the schema needs a string, so checkedAgainst.version is empty and build-catalog will report drift. The build script also needs the audio mod pack gta-sa-ps2-style-mod-pack_1786856007_737162.7z, as the repository specifies. BUILD_AND_INSTALL installs the APK itself, so the install-apk step is only for a user who built it separately. The repository has no releases.
